title: Startup satisfies the length invariant
statement: For every bit string $x$, if its startup state has consumed length $u$ and fresh cursor $f$, then $u\le |x|$ and $f\le |x|+u$.
hypotheses_covered: Startup state is the state selected for $x$
replaced:
For every input string $x$, the startup seam state of $x$ satisfies the length
invariant on $x$; this holds both for the valid and for the fallback startup
state.
